content.query:
SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId, MAX(BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate) AS MaxStartDate, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
            FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId
            INNER JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.CustomerAccountId = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CustomerAccountId
            AND BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.SerialNumber = BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.SerialNumber
            INNER JOIN BNKM.Customer ON BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation.CoreCustomerId = BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId
            WHERE 
            BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory.RecordTypeId IN ('M', 'J') AND
            BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND
            BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
            ---BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.PeriodStartDate = '20230112'
            GROUP BY BNKM.Customer.CoreCustomerId, BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance.CustomerAccountId
